channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: U.S. economy added 165,000 jobs in October, way more than expected; unemployment rate at 4.1%
item.description: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to increase by 59,000 in October as the unemployment rate held steady at 4.2%.

item.title: Democratic sweep gives markets a reason to rethink path of interest rates
item.description: Rate hikes could be curbed by an Iran war resolution, slower U.S. growth and fresh fiscal policy — but none are set in stone.

item.title: Tesla to wind down Cybertruck production in Texas next year to ramp Cybercab, Musk says
item.description: The Cybertruck and its polarizing design gained a niche following, but it did not achieve mass-market sales and Tesla has issued several voluntary recalls.

item.title: Nasdaq drops into correction territory — here’s what typically happens next
item.description: Nasdaq’s slide into correction territory puts its history of recoveries in focus. Here's what history shows.

item.title: Dan Ives says tech rout is 'golden buying opportunity' just like during Covid, tariff sell-off
item.description: Technology stocks are sinking after Democrats regained control of Congress earlier this week, creating buying opportunities in the market, per analyst Dan Ives.

item.title: Market sell-off hits hard: Advisors say 'stay the course with an eye on buying'
item.description: As retail investors pulled money out of individual stocks, more than three-quarters of advisors in a CNBC flash poll said investors should check their allocation against their goals or stay invested.

item.title: Moderna raises 2026 outlook as CEO says newer vaccines are gaining traction
item.description: The biotech company now expects 2026 revenue growth of 15% to 25%, up from its previous guidance of up to 10%.

item.title: Montana votes to ban corporate political money. Next stop? Probably the Supreme Court
item.description: Montana voters approved a novel strategy to restrict corporate political spending, setting up a constitutional fight that could reach the Supreme Court.

item.title: AI debt concerns grow as ING reportedly seeks buyers for $500 million of data center loans
item.description: ING is reportedly seeking bids for about $500 million across 12 data center loans, including debt tied to a New Mexico Stargate site.

item.title: Where's the growth? Legacy automakers face a tougher 2027 as costs rise, market tightens
item.description: Automakers are warning about higher commodity, logistics and memory costs, while pricing power is becoming harder to extend to consumers.

item.title: Mississippi Senate: Colom, Hyde-Smith gird for ballot legal fight in razor-thin race
item.description: The Mississippi Senate election could be determined by the mail-in ballots received after Election Day, whose legality was upheld by the Supreme Court.

item.title: 'The whole landscape changed': Gaming CEOs see new opportunities post-midterms
item.description: Midterm results opened new gambling opportunities in Texas and other states while raising scrutiny of prediction-market operators.

item.title: Small retailers brace for 'huge hit' this holiday season as shipping costs spike
item.description: As shipping costs surge due to high fuel prices, smaller and medium-sized retailers struggle to keep up, and they face a difficult holiday season.

item.title: Outside groups urge congressional Dems to target corporate interests over Trump
item.description: Groups and strategists advising Democrats are warning them to use their investigative tools on corporate interests, rather than on President Donald Trump.

item.title: Could CRISPR cure rare diseases before birth? Scientists are getting closer
item.description: Researchers are exploring fetal gene editing to treat rare genetic disorders before they cause lasting damage.

item.title: Here are Friday's biggest analyst calls: Nvidia, SpaceX, Netflix, Apple, TripAdvisor, Molson Coors & more
item.description: Here are the biggest calls on Wall Street on Friday.

item.title: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Moderna, Airbnb, Cloudflare, Affirm & more
item.description: These are some of the stocks posting the largest moves premarket.

item.title: A long-term Elon Musk backer is cashing out of Tesla — and cutting its SpaceX exposure
item.description: Scottish Mortgage Investment Trust has cut its SpaceX holding to 11.1% of assets and sold its remaining Tesla stake.

item.title: Dynasties or Parity? How MLB, the NFL, and the NBA try to find competitive balance
item.description: MLB executive tells CNBC dynasties can be 'wonderful' for a league if spending rules are fair for all teams.

item.title: Neocloud IREN says $4 billion in annualized revenue being delayed due to customer request
item.description: Following a dramatic plunge in its stock price, IREN said some revenue is being delayed from 2026 until early next year.

item.title: Costco is taking aim at its May record high — how it got here and where's it going
item.description: Costco is finally back.

item.title: Pay now, buy later: 3 tips to help take the surprise out of unexpected expenses
item.description: Everything from holiday gift shopping to car maintenance is a little less stressful when you plan ahead.

item.title: Nvidia's Huang is asked to brief Congress on reported Chinese spy relationship
item.description: President Donald Trump was briefed about a year ago about those intelligence findings, The New York Times reported.

item.title: HSA-eligible health plans in 2027: What to know about tax savings vs. higher deductibles
item.description: Many employees are eligible to choose an HSA-eligible high-deductible health plan during open enrollment. Here's what to know before enrolling.

item.title: AI stocks hammered by midterm shock as data center buildout becomes a 'war of attrition'
item.description: The election rout landed on an AI trade already under pressure from high interest rates, heavy capital spending and questions about returns.

item.title: Hoax bomb threats repeatedly disrupt flights across Europe this week. Here’s what we know
item.description: Dozens of flights across Europe reported bomb threats this week, disrupting air travel across London, Dublin, and Helsinki.

item.title: Drones are changing warfare. But defense giants are still making billions from old-school weapons
item.description: The world's biggest defense firms are finding that demand for traditional military equipment remains strong even as drones and AI reshape how wars are fought.

item.title: Oil prices set for sharp weekly fall after midterm elections as investors weigh Iran conflict risk
item.description: Oil prices fell Friday as investors weighed the risk of renewed Iran war escalation after the midterms, alongside prospects for a diplomatic breakthrough.

item.title: EU charges TikTok over harmful algorithmic 'rabbit hole' effects
item.description: TikTok's Chinese owner ByteDance risks a fine next year of up to 6% of its global annual turnover unless it can resolve the issue.

item.title: The 'World's Best Airline' is updating its business and first-class experience
item.description: Singapore Airlines is rolling out new onboard seating, dining and entertainment options that are part of an over $2 billion Singapore dollar investment.
